messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
**Best months to visit Hawaii**

| Month | Avg. high (°F / °C) | Avg. low (°F / °C) | Rainfall (in / mm) | Notes |
|-------|---------------------|--------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **April** | 78 °F / 26 °C | 63 °F / 17 °C | 2.5 in / 64 mm | Mild weather, fewer crowds, good deals on accommodations. |
| **May** | 80 °F / 27 °C | 65 °F / 18 °C | 2.3 in / 58 mm | Warm, sunny days, still off‑peak pricing. |
| **September** | 81 °F / 27 °C | 66 °F / 19 °C | 1.8 in / 46 mm | Post‑summer lull, great surf conditions, lower rates. |
| **October** | 80 °F / 27 °C | 65 °F / 18 °C | 2.0 in / 51 mm | Pleasant temperatures, fewer tourists, still good for beach and hiking. |

### Why these months?

| Factor | Why it matters |
|--------|----------------|
| **Weather** | Temperatures stay comfortably warm (mid‑70s to low‑80s °F) with minimal humidity. |
| **Crowds** | These months fall outside the peak summer (June‑August) and holiday (December‑January) periods, so you’ll encounter fewer crowds at popular sites and beaches. |
| **Prices** | Hotels, flights, and tours are typically cheaper than in peak season, giving you more value for money. |
| **Activities** | Surfing, snorkeling, and hiking conditions are excellent. Rainfall is lower than in the winter months, so outdoor plans are less likely to be disrupted. |

### Quick recommendation

If you’re looking for the best overall balance of pleasant weather, lower crowds, and reasonable prices, **April, May, September, or October** are your top choices. If you prefer the absolute warmest temperatures and don’t mind higher prices, late summer (June‑July) is also fine—but expect larger crowds and higher rates.
